title: UncleanExit
description: An observed unclean exit: the last page died with game frames live. Never sampled.

frames.description: The game frames that were live when the page died.

host_profile.description: The host profile, such as reels version 0.

FrameState.description: Whether a game frame is the one on screen. Reels calls an inactive frame preloaded.

oneOf.description: On screen, after the host's active message.

LiveFrame.description: A game frame that was live when the page died.

build_version.description: From the frame URL, such as "v12" from `/v12/`. Null when the URL has none.

mount_age_ms.description: Time since the frame was mounted.

ready_seen.description: Whether the host saw the game's ready message.

ProfileRef.description: Which host profile, and which version of it, a result used.
